statement: The five largest U.S. cloud providers are reported to have added roughly $750 billion to their combined 2026-2027 AI investment forecasts, bringing the two-year total to about $1.89 trillion, a 66% increase since the start of 2026.
why: The direction of hyperscaler capex revision is the single strongest forward driver of merchant-GPU orders, but this document's figures are an aggregation the author could not tie to a primary note.

impact.mechanism: Upward capex revisions at the five largest buyers flow directly into accelerator, memory, fabric and data-center procurement.

evidence.excerpt: The five largest U.S. cloud providers have accelerated their AI buildout plans, adding roughly '$750 billion' to their combined investment forecasts for 2026 and 2027.

confidence.basis: Wire/social aggregation crediting unnamed strategists and social-media posts; the document states no underlying Goldman note or major-wire article confirming the $1.89 trillion two-year figure was found, and the nearest verifiable Goldman figures are different and lower.

entity: hyperscalers (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Oracle, Meta); Goldman Sachs
